        lastName:

          type: string

        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility as a
            flat single-line address; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes

            an 'addressLine2' is present.

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input and is normalized the same
            way (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations
            expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. a unit
            or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' with
            its country code is kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be
            a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when
            supplied it is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it
            must be 4 digits and, when the owner's city has a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'

            another owner already has the same lastName and postcode (they share a household);
            otherwise such a household duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict. It only bypasses
            the duplicate block; the household link itself is always derived. Not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true

                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the owner's normalized lastName and

              readOnly: true

                409 in that case.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F9A2C7B1D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-

              type: integer

              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from the city using the fixed city-to-region

              readOnly: true

              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

              example: false

              example: false
